paras: Our V5 auto door handles make access and use simpler and more convenient. Installing them allows you to open the door by simply pulling the handle, removing the need to press as well.
Additionally, LED lights within the handles can provide additional light to the area surrounding the car, creating a more welcoming ambiance.
hl: Heavy duty motor boasts 100,000+ cycles ensuring reliable long lasting durability
Utilising high quality components, these handles are engineered to endure even the harshest of weather conditions, and elements.
Effortless installation - There is no need to run wires through door jambs to a main module.
Colourful welcome lights - Doubling up as puddle light, customise the light with dynamic colour switching (White, Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Purple, Rainbow)
